text:
jas: FYI I noticed a handful of 404 fragment errors in prod docs this morning: /guides/upgrade#migration-notes and /api/clients#python-typed. linkcheck flagged them after the docusaurus switch.

lina: yep, saw the same. seems like a mix of slug changes (colons, parentheses) and some headings swallowed by MDX frontmatter.

omar: quick reproduction steps i used: `git checkout prod-docs && yarn build && npx serve build` then visit the failing fragment URL. Docusaurus prints the slug it generated in the HTML id attribute, so you can diff.

jas: i opened a small PR to add explicit ids and adjust a few inbound links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 (WIP). includes a test harness change to run linkcheck against the production build artifact.

build-bot: buildkite/docs-validate #1078 failed: 3 missing fragments detected: `/guides/upgrade#migration-notes`, `/api/clients#python-typed`, `/tutorials/compose#embedded-examples`.

lina: thanks. two practical patterns we should standardize: 1) for headings with punctuation/emoji/inline code -> add explicit id: `## Migration notes {#migration-notes}`; 2) for headings adjacent to imports/codefences make sure the heading line is separated by a blank line so parser picks it up.

omar: i ran into a weird one where a heading used backticks: ``### Using `Client()``` produced slug `using-client-1` in docusaurus. explicit id is the only stable fix.

jas: agree. im going to add a short style blurb under "Contributor Guide > Writing docs" and update the docs lint rule to warn when headings contain non-ascii or inline code without an explicit id.

lina: for linkcheck, i added a small test to tools/linkcheck/tests that builds a tiny mkdocs/docusaurus fixture and asserts fragment presence. snippet: 
```bash
# run from repo root
yarn build:docs && ./tools/linkcheck/check_fragments.sh build /tmp/linkcheck-report
```

jas: nice. also adding a small script to canonicalize heading ids across the repo for the migration: `scripts/normalize-headers --paths docs/ --pattern "s/\`|\:|\(|\)//g"` (throwaway until we settle style).

build-bot: buildkite/docs-validate #1081 (re-run) in progress...

docs-ci: buildkite/docs-validate #1081 succeeded: no missing fragments.

omar: merged PR 4789 at 1775556705. left a follow-up issue to sweep internal `/integrations/` links (there are a few older anchors still using mkdocs slugs).

lina: tiny follow-up: let's document the explicit-id rule + an example table in the style guide so contributors can copy/paste. i'll add that in a new PR.

jas: thanks all. leaving a release-note line: "docs: stabilize heading anchors by requiring explicit ids for headings with punctuation/emoji/code; add linkcheck fixtures to catch regressions."

omar: :thumbsup: closing the loop.
